CrowdHuman AP and Caltech log-average MR evaluator from Megvii's CrowdDetection.

Source: https://github.com/megvii-model/CrowdDetection/tree/master/evaluate/APMRToolkits
Downloaded: 2026-10-06. image.py, database.py and __init__.py are unmodified.
The upstream Apache-2.0 license is included in LICENSE. Source hashes are recorded
with the experiment provenance. Original ODGT annotations remain unchanged;
prediction records supply image width and height required by the evaluator.
